title: 第13章猜测第14章黑市
slug: 莫欺老年穷一天增加一个天赋点
lines: “如果是按照这么算的话，那么90-100的根骨就是堪比上上根骨了，可要是突破了一百……”
“又是什么层次的根骨？”
就目前而言，陈安对根骨的了解，仅仅只是从下下根骨到上上根骨，至于上上根骨之上又是什么层次……
陈安就不太了解了。
不过……
陈安的心中有一丝丝的明悟。
“或许，等到我的根骨点数突破了100之后，会发生不一样的变化！”
陈安轻轻的说着，嘴角泛起了一抹笑意。
陈安盘膝坐在硬板床上，双目紧闭，心神却沉浸在丹田气海之中。
那股凝练如铅汞的气血，雄浑磅礴，奔流间发出沉闷的低吼，仿佛一头即将挣脱枷锁的凶兽。
四百九十九公斤。
距离王铁口中那气血关圆满的五百公斤门槛，只差一线。
寻常武者若到此境，恐怕早已欣喜若狂，迫不及待地准备冲击下一境界。
但陈安的心，却静如古井。
“五百公斤，只是常人的圆满。”
他想起了那个叫林枫的少年，上中根骨，又有整个风云镖局的资源倾斜，他的目标，绝不可能仅仅是这区区五百公斤。
而自己呢？
七十二点的根骨，大成境界的《鲸吞功》，这难道就是极限？
“不，我的极限，远不止于此。”
陈安心念一动，那个模糊的预感再次浮现。
“当根骨达到一百点时，或许会发生某种难以想象的质变。”
“在那之前，我必须将脚下的根基，打磨到真正的完美无瑕！”
“气血狼烟，不急。”
“反正都已经六十岁了，倒也不急一时。”
翌日，天光微熹。
演武场上已经聚满了新入门的学徒，喧闹声此起彼伏。
陈安依旧站在那个最不起眼的角落，看着演武场的位置。
很快，总镖头王铁龙行虎步而来。
他没有多余的废话，在场中央站定，沉腰立马，开始演练每日一次的《鲸吞功》。
在那些学徒眼中，王铁的拳法依旧是那般霸道刚猛，深奥难解。
可在悟性高达十五点的陈安眼中，今日的景象，却截然不同。
王铁的《鲸吞功》，早已臻至圆满。
他的一招一式，不再是纯粹的霸道，而是多了一种收放自如、吞吐随心的圆融韵味。
双臂开合，气流在他周身竟形成一个肉眼难见的微小漩涡，每一次呼吸，都仿佛与这方天地的脉动悄然合一。
王铁演练完毕，收功而立。
“接下来自行修炼！”
他转身离去，学徒们则立刻散开，开始自行修炼。
陈安则是沉浸在刚刚观摩王铁的鲸吞功之中。
喧闹声中，几道压低了却依旧难掩震惊的议论声，清晰地传入陈安耳中。
“听说了吗？林枫师兄……他闭关出来了！”
“何止是出来了！我亲眼看到，他在测力桩上，一拳……一拳打出了四百八十公斤！”
“我的天！这才多久？半个月前不是才二百三十六公斤吗？这……这是妖怪吧！”
一个消息灵通的学徒压低声音，语气里充满了狂热与艳羡：“这算什么！我听内堂的师兄说，大当家对林师兄的期望极高！根本不满足于五百公斤就突破，而是要让他冲击那气血极限！”
content_en:
"If calculated in this way, then a bone of 90-100 is comparable to the upper bone, but if it exceeds 100..."
"What level of root is it?"
For now, Chen An's understanding of root bones is only from the lower root bones to the upper root bones. As for what levels are above the upper root bones...
Chen An didn't know much about it.
But...
There was a hint of enlightenment in Chen An's heart.
"Perhaps, when my root bone points exceed 100, different changes will occur!"
Chen An said softly, with a smile on his lips.
Chen An sat cross-legged on the hard bed, his eyes closed tightly, but his mind was immersed in the sea of ​​energy in his Dantian.
The energy and blood, as condensed as lead and mercury, were powerful and majestic, and they let out a dull roar as they flowed, like a ferocious beast about to break free from its shackles.
Four hundred and ninety-nine kilograms.
It was just a hair away from the 500 kilogram threshold that Wang Tiekou said would be the perfect level of Qi and Blood.
If an ordinary warrior reached this level, he would probably be ecstatic and eager to prepare for the next level.
But Chen An's heart was as quiet as an ancient well.
"Five hundred kilograms is just the perfection of ordinary people."
He thought of the young man named Lin Feng, who had a middle-aged man and had the resources of the entire Fengyun Escort Bureau at his disposal. His goal could never be just a mere 500 kilograms.
And what about yourself?
With seventy-two points of bones and the "Whale Swallowing Skill" at the Dacheng state, is this the limit?
"No, my limit is far beyond that."
Chen An thought about it, and that vague premonition emerged again.
"When the root bone reaches one hundred points, some unimaginable qualitative change may occur."
"Before that, I must polish the foundation under my feet until it is truly flawless!"
"The blood is full of smoke, don't be impatient."
"Anyway, I'm already sixty years old, so I'm not in a hurry."
…
The next day, the sky was dim.
The martial arts arena was already filled with new apprentices, and there was a lot of noise.
Chen An was still standing in the most inconspicuous corner, looking at the location of the martial arts arena.
Soon, the chief bodyguard, Wang Tielong, came at a quick pace.
Without any unnecessary nonsense, he stood still in the middle of the field, lowered his waist and immediately began to practice the "Whale Swallowing Skill" once a day.
In the eyes of those apprentices, Wang Tie's boxing skills were still so domineering, fierce, and profound.
But in the eyes of Chen An, who has a level of understanding as high as fifteen, today's scene is completely different.
Wang Tie's "Whale Swallowing Skill" has already reached perfection.
His moves are no longer purely domineering, but have a mellow charm that can be freely controlled and controlled as he wishes.
Opening and closing his arms, the airflow around him formed a tiny vortex that was invisible to the naked eye. Every breath seemed to be quietly one with the pulse of the world.
"Huh..."
Wang Tie finished the drill and stood up after collecting his achievements.
"Next, practice on your own!"
He turned and left, and the apprentices immediately dispersed and began to practice on their own.
Chen An was immersed in watching Wang Tie's whale swallowing skill just now.
Among the noise, a few muted but still shocked comments reached Chen An's ears clearly.
"Have you heard? Senior Brother Lin Feng...he has come out of seclusion!"
"It's not just that he came out! I saw with my own eyes that he punched 480 kilograms with one punch on the force measuring pile!"
"Oh my God! How long has it been? Wasn't it only 236 kilograms half a month ago? This...is this a monster?"
A well-informed apprentice lowered his voice, and his tone was full of enthusiasm and envy: "What is this! I heard from the senior brother in the inner hall that the master has extremely high expectations for senior brother Lin! He is not satisfied with breaking through at 500 kilograms, but wants him to hit the limit of energy and blood!"
